integrity: Mathematical proof supported by reproducible exact-rational finite checks. Self-review only; no external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Balanced bipartitions n>=3, one perfect matching of relative price t>0, continuous undirected conductances and budget one; interior scalar root is implicit. Fixed-price and t=1+s/n limits only, not arbitrary varying-price sequences. General conductance optimization, unweighted crown invariants, and equal-price bicliques are prior results. Exact first online date 2006-09-05 belongs to the first listed graph-resistance source; the conference version of the optimization source is dated only to the July 2006 event in available material, so no specific earlier public day is asserted. Equivalent older specialized results cannot be ruled out.
title: The matching-price deletion frontier for resistance-optimal balanced bicliques
